claims.claim: 主張：正方行列の積の指数ωはどの体の上でもちょうど9/4（n×n行列）。上限は既知で、今回は下限
claims.evidence: Abstract：We prove that the exponent of square matrix multiplication is 9/4 over every field. The upper bound was known. Theorem 1.1

claims.claim: n≥2のどのnでも、算術回路は少なくとも⌈n^{9/4}/2⌉個の乗算か除算のゲートが必要
claims.evidence: Abstract および第1節：for every n ≥ 2 a circuit for two n × n matrices requires at least ⌈n^{9/4}/2⌉ multiplication or division gates

claims.claim: 上限9/4は複素数上ではOpenAIの10月2日付の原稿、どの体の上でもAmanov・van den Berg・Zuiddamが示した
claims.evidence: 第1節：The 9/4 upper bound was established over C by OpenAI [41] and over every field by Amanov, van den Berg and Zuiddam [5]。文献[41]は OAI:Matrix-Multiplication-Nine-Fourths-October-2-2026

claims.claim: 証明の筋道：指数が小さいとテンソルネットワークを圧縮しすぎ、リストの要素が互いに異なるかの判定の下限に反する
claims.evidence: Abstract：a smaller exponent would compress tensor networks enough to violate a lower bound for testing whether the entries in each of several independent lists are distinct

claims.claim: 形式証明の範囲：除算を使わない回路についてLeanで指数9/4を証明
claims.evidence: Lean formalization 節：The Lean development proves the square exponent 9/4 for division-free circuits computing formal polynomial identities over every field
